about.title: Yuba City Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Sutter County households rely daily on everyday products, from kitchen appliances to farm and industrial equipment used around the Garden Highway agricultural corridors. When one of those products fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the injuries can be serious and the medical bills can pile up fast. California law generally allows injured people to pursue a strict liability claim, meaning you don't have to prove the manufacturer was careless — only that the product was defective and that the defect caused your harm. That said, these cases often involve multiple parties: the manufacturer, a distributor, and the retailer who sold it. Our team can evaluate what happened, help identify who may be responsible, and explain your options — all without any upfront cost, since we work on contingency.

items.title: Strict Liability Can Ease Your Burden
items.desc: California generally lets you pursue a claim by showing the product was defective and caused your injury, without having to prove the manufacturer was negligent.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable, and we can help sort out which parties belong in your claim.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: Because the defective item itself is often key evidence, our team can advise you early on how to safely keep and document it for your case.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was careless?
items.answer: Not necessarily. California product liability claims often proceed under strict liability, meaning the focus is on whether the product was defective and caused your injury, not on the manufacturer's state of mind. We can review your situation and explain which theory best fits your facts.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep the product exactly as it was at the time of the injury, including any packaging, instructions, or parts. This evidence is often central to a product liability claim, so avoid repairing or discarding it before speaking with us.

items.question: Is this connected to Yuba City's traffic crash data?

items.question: What does it cost to speak with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing upfront. We provide a free consultation, and we typically work on contingency, meaning we only get paid if you recover compensation.
